summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing U.S. FDA accelerated approval of Tzield (teplizumab-mzwv) for recently diagnosed stage 3 type 1 diabetes in children aged 8–17. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory update regarding a product approval, not a corporate event requiring classification under special-situations categories.
